summary_en: ¥100M upper limit, 300,000 shares (0.79% of 37.77M shares outstanding ex-treasury), price ceiling not disclosed, execution 16 Jul–30 Oct 2026, open-market or ToSTNeT-3 method.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Terms of Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
SYLA Holdings Co., Ltd. announced on 15 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire up to 300,000 common shares of the company. The acquisition will be conducted under Articles 156 and 165(3) of the Companies Act.

The program terms are: maximum ¥100M in total outlay; execution window 16 July through 30 October 2026; method to be open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange or ToSTNeT-3 off-auction transaction. The 300,000-share limit represents 0.79% of the 37,768,728 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock as of the announcement date). No price ceiling per share is disclosed.

The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency, return value to shareholders, and enable flexible and responsive capital allocation in response to business conditions. As of the announcement, the company held 4,333,034 treasury shares, including 252,000 shares held in a stock-grant trust account.
